contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy coin, a Nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-337), Reece period 17 (AD 330-348). Arles mint AD 332-333. RIC VII Arles 358. Obverse: Diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Legend: CONSTANTI-NVS MAX AVG. Reverse: Two soldiers with sheilds and spears, two standards between. Legend: GLOR-IA EXERC-ITVS. Mint mark: branch//[S/P]CON[ST].
